messages:
Claire: PTAL — I pushed a followup: addressed your comments about the shard fallback and renamed the config flag. Added an e2e covering the degenerate routing case. Will squash if we're happy. CI is currently running.
Ravi: Thanks — quick q: did you keep the old env var alias? some infra relies on SHARD_FALLBACK_DISABLED
Claire: Yes — kept alias for one release; updated comment. Diff snippet: ```diff
--- a/service/config.go
+++ b/service/config.go
@@ -42,6 +42,10 @@
 func init() {
     // kept legacy alias for backward compat
+    // NOTE: remove after 1.2.0 rollout
     if os.Getenv("SHARD_FALLBACK_DISABLED") != "" {
         cfg.Fallback = false
     }
 }
```
Sam: Can you also add a short note in CHANGES.md? ops likes explicit migration notes. Otherwise :+1: from me once CI green.
Ravi: Small nit: rename variable 'fallbackTTL' to 'fallbackGrace' in the test. Makes intent clearer.
Claire: Good call — done. PTAL again @Ravi @Sam. Rebased on main and squashed the extra WIP commit.
merge-bot: merge-bot queued for canary window at 2025-03-20T15:00Z — will merge after CI passes and 2 approvals.
Sam: :thumbsup: I can approve in ~30m after my current meeting.
Claire: Thanks — I left a comment with the failing output from the flaky test; re-ran locally with `go test -run TestShardFallback -count=10` and it's stable now. If no objections, please approve and merge after CI.
Ravi: LGTM, approving now. :ok_hand: 
Sam: Approving. :rocket: 
Claire: Thanks all — merge-bot should merge when CI is green. I'll open a tiny follow-up to add an observability metric I forgot.
